title: Roblox Forsaken OC Maker 2026: Build Your Own Survivor or Killer Character
summary: Unlike traditional Forsaken OC Maker with static image, Redbean let you build your own playable version of Veeronica or Guest 1337, free on iOS & Android
body_markdown:
**[Forsaken](https://www.roblox.com/games/18687417158/Forsaken)** is a popular multiplayer survival horror game on Roblox: eight Survivors try to escape one Killer before The Spectre’s world catches them. Its cast borrows from Roblox’s internet mythology, turning hackers and old legends like Guest 1337, Shedletsky, and 1x1x1x1 into Survivors and Killers with real backstories and their own cosmetic skins. That lore, plus dark arcs, keeps the fandom building their own versions of these characters instead of just playing them in-game.


A Forsaken OC Maker usually just means a place to design a skin from a concept, a base, and a role. **Redbean** is built for more than that: ***create characters that feel alive in your own Forsaken world*** – recreate Forsaken’s unique characters, your original characters (OC) who you can actually talk to, and play out all kinds of scenarios you write yourself.

##


Forsaken Characters and Forsaken OC Ideas


#


The game’s nostalgic character concepts, creative storytelling and asymmetrical mechanics that support character design have kept fans engaged, building a lively subculture of artists and writers who create fan art, explore lore theories and showcase their unique Forsaken OC ideas – their own Survivor or Killer characters – on social platforms like TikTok and Reddit.


###


Survivors


#


Survivors work as a team to finish objectives and escape before the Killer catches them, each with a distinct ability set.


**Veeronica** is a rebellious robot with a magenta TV for a head, a spray can, and a skateboard, one of two surviving prototypes from an experimental “Helper RO-Bots” program meant to guide Robloxians before it was scrapped. Her unique playstyle and bittersweet lore make her a massive favorite for fan content and[Forsaken Veeronica OC](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/veeronica-tkayllmz7wde) ideas.


**Guest 1337** is a battle-scarred soldier from The Last Guest, a fan movie about the last guest on Roblox fighting a genocidal empire, his number itself is leetspeak for “elite.” His protector role and tragic backstory make him a favorite for[Forsaken Guest 1337 OC](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/guest-1337-bbtplh1m2ye7) concepts built around loyalty and sacrifice.


**[Shedletsky](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/shedletsky-jr2i7u8l8j6t)** is a free starter Survivor based on Roblox’s real former Creative Director, reimagined as a retired admin who fights with a Linked Sword and heals with fried chicken. His humor hides a darker history: he’s the reason 1x1x1x1 exists.


**[Two Time](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/two-time-bnb8pjq757is)** is a member of the Spawn Cult who murdered their closest friend, Azure, chasing a second life, and can now respawn once per round because of it. That single act of betrayal is the fandom’s most retold piece of Forsaken lore.


The rest of the roster includes:[007n7](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/007n7-lxp6mre2po5x) ,[Chance](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/chance-uwral9gyufh3) ,[Dusekkar](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/dusekkars-rl1myp5pa1p0) ,[Elliot](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/elliot-builder-uk3rjgo01kjw) ,[Builderman](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/builderman-jir1tyssf18q) ,[Noob](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/noob-2007-45iwnwoi4mw2) , and Taph.


###


Killers


#


Killers hunt Survivors with a Malice Meter and abilities built to control the map.


**[Azure](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/azure-e9was6r66bwj)** is the payoff to Two Time’s story: after being murdered by them, The Spectre drags Aspen back as Azure, also called[Azurewrath](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/azurewrath-ikwl4ba89w61) , a plant-controlling monster tied to the cult that killed him.


[c00lkidd](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/c00lkidd-jece3zgyp7i7) is a red, fleshy Robloxian based on a real early-2010s Roblox hacking group, raised by fellow Survivor 007n7 after being left on his doorstep. Now a free starter Killer, his minions and map vandalism echo that group’s real exploits. (deanrodg5_qmki)


**[1x1x1x1](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/1x1x1x1-du0krwvs5dty)** is a black, glitching entity with twin blades, based on Roblox’s oldest urban legend about a hacker who despises the third dimension. In Forsaken’s lore, he’s literally the hatred Shedletsky tore out of himself, which is why the two despise each other on sight.


**[Guest 666](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/guest-666-pmaoauackqtm)** rounds out the lineup: a former Guest turned demonic beast after cheating to keep up with her only friend Noob, alongside[John Doe](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/john-doe-ndw45xpge7e1) , Noli,[Nosferatu](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/nosferatu-60kw10u6dglr) , and[Slasher](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/slasher-r3bl9lhcg65w) .


##


Forsaken OC Maker – How to Create Your Own Survivor or Killer Character


#


With your own Forsaken OC ideas inspired by the game, you can start creating a character by deciding on a specific role, Survivor or Killer, then build out a visual concept, a piece of lore, and a special ability around it.


- For a Survivor, pair one active ability with one passive perk tied to a personality trait. For example, your own Forsaken Veeronica OC can be reckless and self-reliant, so she can skate around leaving graffiti that recharges her battery.
- Design a Killer concept: pick a signature weapon and one map-pressure ability that controls space instead of just dealing damage, the way Azure’s plants punish sound or 1x1x1x1’s ranged slash punishes distance. Either stick to a horror theme or change into any theme you love.
- When writing lore, borrow a real piece of Roblox legends or invent a new one. In-game characters like Shedletsky or Guest 1337 are actually based on real former Roblox myths. Another version of Elliot could be a soft-spoken, calm survivor who puts others before himself.


###


Forsaken Character Maker Tools


#


You can buy cosmetics and skins, but you can’t bring your own Forsaken OC into the official game. When searching for a Forsaken OC generator or Forsaken character maker, players can explore Custom Forsaken Creator (on Roblox) or drawing tools like ibisPaint as a place to design and customize their own characters and skins. Or FANsaken, a fan-made project featuring custom character concepts and community writing, can also be inspiration for your lore writing.


However, the experience is mostly built for desktop and doesn’t run well on phone, and none of these Forsaken character maker tools make it alive in a real game world, though. You can change how it looks and write its personality, but it still stops as a static image once you close the creator.


###


Build Your Own Forsaken Version with Your Forsaken OCs in Redbean


#


**Redbean** is a mobile sandbox (free-to-play on iOS & Android) for OC/fandom creators and roleplayers to **actually play with your OCs** , not a static character-image generator or another Forsaken OC Maker that only hands you a look. You can build your own Survivor OC, Killer OC, pixel version of Guest 1337 or Azure, define their personas, lore and any kind of relationships, then **make them come alive in a living Forsaken-inspired town** shaped entirely by you.


What you can do in Redbean:


- Create your character from a photo/image or a sketch, or draw from scratch. Turn your imagination into a playable pixel character that can move, talk, and react.
- Write their persona and lore. Recreate Veeronica as she plays in-game, give Guest 1337 a new backstory, or build your own Survivor. Add them as your own NPCs/townspeople, and they react naturally to story as who you write them to be, remember what happens, relationships and plots evolve the more you talk.
- Set character connections: build your own version of the Two Time and Azure dynamic, or a rivalry nobody’s written yet.
- Shape your own town: Describe a Forsaken-style setting in a few words and Redbean puts a pixel version together for you to walk around in. Design your own world in any theme you love and write anything that could happen in it: from a horror, haunted town to a peaceful beach or medieval market.
- Your characters and NPCs keep living when you’re not directing them: they wander around the town, meet and interact with each other. Build a multiverse or a Forsaken AU from your imagination: your Forsaken OC, Veeronica, Two Time or Noob can share a town with Barney, Ratthew from Animal Hospital, Pomni from TADC, and any character from game/show you love.
- Explore other players’ towns and characters through the Explore tab. Or make your own town public so other players can visit and play with your unique world.


##


FAQ


#


###


Which Forsaken characters get the most fan art and OC recreations?


#


Forsaken Guest 1337 OC tops most tier lists and shows up constantly in fan recreations, alongside a Forsaken Veeronica OC and the Two Time x Azure pairing, which carries the fandom’s most-discussed backstory. New characters also catch a wave of OC ideas right after their reveal, such as The Stalker as an upcoming Killer and The Ring Master as a new Survivor.


###


What is Redbean? What makes it different from other Forsaken OC Maker options?


#


Redbean is a free mobile sandbox for building a living world and roleplaying with your alive characters, beyond designing how a character looks. Unlike other Forsaken OC Maker tools that stop at design, **inside Redbean your OCs don’t just exist** – they can think, talk, move around, react to scenarios and continue living even when you’re not there. A whole Forsaken-inspired town can be shaped entirely by you: your own Survivors and Killers, your own plot for Two Time and Azure, and even an AU where your Forsaken OC could live together with the cast from other games/shows.


###


How do I make my own Forsaken OC, survivor or killer, using a Forsaken OC Maker like Redbean?


#


Start with what you already know: a role, a rough look, and one defining trait or backstory beat. In Redbean, that turns into a real character once you upload a photo/image/screenshot or sketch it and write a short persona, with no drawing skill required.


###


How do I turn a Forsaken OC or fanart I already have into a character in Redbean?


#


Upload the fanart, sketch or reference image directly in Redbean’s character creator, or draw from scratch in Redbean’s in-app drawing tool, and it becomes a playable pixel character you can name, give a persona or lore, define speaking style, and drop into your town, whether the original is your own OC or a canon character.


###


Is there a way to make a Forsaken-style character without drawing it by hand?


#


Yes. A photo works the same way a sketch does. Take a screenshot of your favorite or upload a picture of a figure or outfit, and Redbean turns it into a pixel character that can move around, think and talk.


###


Besides Forsaken OCs, can I make other characters in Redbean?


#


Yes. Redbean isn’t limited to one fandom, so the same mechanics work for any original character or a cast from a completely different universe – your Forsaken OCs can share a town with characters from other games like Animal Hospital or series like TADC, The Walten Files. Browse the in-app Explore tab or Redbean’s character gallery for more Forsaken OC ideas or OC inspiration.


Whatever you imagine for these characters, Redbean is where it can actually play out. It’s free on iOS and Android, and every character and story you build stays yours.
